description: "An Earnest Exhortation to a Frequent Reception of the Holy Sacrament of the Lord’s Supper" by an unnamed Layman is a religious tract likely written in the early 19th century. This work focuses on encouraging Christians, particularly young people, to partake in the Holy Sacrament of the Lord's Supper frequently, emphasizing its importance in the Christian faith as a commandment of Jesus.
